item.title: ‘I have loved every single moment’: Frankie Dettori retires on double win after living ‘his dream’ for 40 years
item.description: Frankie Dettori, pictured on Champions Day at Ascot in 2023, has retired from race-riding. Frankie Dettori bowed out of his 40-year racing career with a double on his final day in the saddle. The three-time champion jockey brought the curtain down on his sporting career with two wins at Gávea Racecourse in Brazil yesterday (1 February) – including the Grande Prêmio Estado do Rio de Janeiro (Brazilian 2000 Guineas). item.description: Ros Canter and Lordships Graffalo win Burghley 2025, while Ros was pregnant with her second child. item.title: ‘Exceptionally wet ground conditions’ force cancellation of early British Eventing fixture
item.description: Exceptionally wet ground conditions have made it impossible for organisers to prepare for the early-season event at Epworth. Epworth Horse Trials, one of the first two events of the British Eventing (BE) season, has been cancelled owing to “exceptionally wet ground conditions”. Epworth (1) was due to run classes from GO BE80 to BE100plus on Saturday, 7 March. Poplar Park, the other fixture scheduled that weekend, is still due to run in Suffolk […]
